primary_pool: Every at-risk orientation with a stored complete safe coefficient vector, including completed univariate clocks retained in a whole-pair fallback; report coverage and status, do not substitute a paired estimator
direct_event: D=next inserted label belongs to the current H2 direct absorbing set; p=h/d
bound: B=p/(1-p)*(a-m)^2 for 0<p<1; equals Var(E[X|D,prefix]) and lower-bounds full next-label innovation
boundary: h=0 gives B=0; h=d gives T=1, conditional variance=B=0 and no prefix ratio
aggregation: sum B / sum conditional suffix variance, not mean of prefix ratios; preserve each original batch and size/orientation
uncertainty: delete-one-original-batch jackknife, retaining joint canonical/integrated and orientation covariance within each N
remaining: V-B is exactly the weighted within-safe-event variance; it may be explained by safe next-label identity and/or later suffix, not necessarily noise after the whole next label is observed
paired_boundary: not an H4 paired lower bound; no addition of orientation bounds without their shared next-label intersection/covariance
execution: zero DP, zero network/child solves, zero new samples, existing safe coefficients only
